status: Budgets fixed before the first experimental run; not production qualification
direct_sum: gamma_(32*n) times the absolute causal convolution and contraction scale; epsilon=float64 eps
fft: 64*epsilon*ceil(log2(2*n)) times the L1 kernel times maximum absolute drive, plus the direct-sum bound
orientation: gamma_(64*n_angles) for normalized fourth-degree orientation moments
note: ODE budgets are dimensionless after amplitude/time scaling. Gain and carrier targets are proposed acceptance limits, not measured passes. Material uncertainty cannot enlarge an arithmetic bound.
